preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of nodes n in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.
The total number of nodes across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly t relabelings, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(relabeling) == n for relabeling in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each relabeling must be a permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(set(relabeling) == set(range(1, n + 1)) for relabeling in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each relabeling must be a valid permutation of integers from 1 to n.
